statement: Finite CW types have finite poset models; finite-category nerves have finitely presented component fundamental groups but need not be compact.

statement: Restricted set-valued Yoneda on finite-category types or finite CW types is faithful and conservative.
notes: Sym_fin(N) shift is not invertible but induces identity on every test.

statement: Restricted set-valued Yoneda on either finite test category is full.
notes: Uncountable free group and locally chosen disjoint transpositions define non-realizable natural transformation.

statement: No U-small set of unpointed spaces jointly detects all isomorphisms; the symmetric-group proof also fails to separate maps.

statement: Hot is nonconcrete even on simply connected finite-dimensional CW complexes.
notes: Precise theorem invocation; independent of an unverified MMS source.

statement: The degree-two circle telescope has a nonzero H2-cohomology map invisible to all finite-category tests; its finite-stage ind-object maps non-epimorphically to its telescope.
notes: H^2(T;Z), not homology H_2; explicit 2-adic cocycle; repairs misleading finite-CW-only formulation.

statement: Spaces are the infinity-categorical Ind-completion of finite CW types; their space-valued restricted Yoneda is fully faithful.
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: V ms.52; VII ms.121-127; IX ms.9-13
notes: Compact objects are retracts of finite CW types; finite spaces is not used to mean pi-finite.

statement: Space-valued finite-category tests are fully faithful; the given inclusion of all finite-category types does not exhibit spaces as their Ind-completion.
notes: Density extends to larger full testing category by right Kan extension; BC2 obstructs compactness.

statement: For each n>=2 the homotopy n-category is conservative under finite tests; fundamental groupoids of maps from spheres already suffice.
notes: Complete proof using equivariant homomorphisms and orbit sets; handles empty/disconnected spaces.

statement: For finite n the truncated restricted Yoneda is faithful on its highest retained morphisms, and hence fully faithful as an n-functor.
notes: Nonzero alpha in H^2(T;Z)=pi_(n-1) Map(T,K(Z,n+1)) is invisible; n=2 gives phantom homotopy.

statement: With countable CW source finite-CW truncated Yoneda is iso on pi_k for k<n-1 and surjective on pi_(n-1); coherent height-two tests determine map classes.
notes: Statement restricted to countable CW sources; no arbitrary-source transfer.

statement: For finite n>=2 the truncated restricted Yoneda on finite-CW or finite-category tests is full or faithful on ordinary map classes for arbitrary sources.
notes: Locally finite abelian G of cardinal aleph_(n-1) and rational twisted K(M,n) sections refute faithfulness; cardinal aleph_n and nonsplit K(M,n) fibration refute fullness. Every retained pi_k can fail injectivity. Modules obtained from U-small bar syzygies.

statement: Associativity and T^2=1 follow from coherent infinity-level tests; coherent height-two tests suffice for countable CW domains; no fixed finite height gives a general equality criterion for arbitrary sources.
notes: Literal false positives: fibrewise translation T by nonzero rational cohomology section has R_n T=id but T^2!=id; m=T pr_1 is not associative though its coherent finite-height tests are. Does not claim any particular path model fails.
